import sys,pathlib,json,copy
from hashlib import sha256
r=pathlib.Path.cwd().resolve()
sys.path[:0]=[str(r/p) for p in ("api/src","api/tests","integrations/hermes/src","integrations/hermes/tests","integrations/hermes/upstream/managed-source")]
import test_contract_method_checks as h
from omnis.modules.tasks import method_checker_identity as identity
from omnis.modules.settings import candidate_store as records
from omnis.modules.settings.catalog_schema import canonical
from omnis.modules.settings.catalog_models import CatalogError
assert h.ROOT==r and sys.dont_write_bytecode
for m in (h,identity,records):
 assert pathlib.Path(m.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(r)
PIN="1042abaf48dae5e14a7fee5c879b68fb57313f7e53698a43becf5a57e7a52338"
DIGEST="833b5690ada0c2669114dc7fc3755300d96116b773f9eb0c412fba024fac8fd9"
def seal(case,pin):
 b=case.prompt_bundle
 h.obj(b["payload"])["composer_revision"]=pin
 b["digest"]=sha256(canonical({k:v for k,v in b.items() if k!="digest"})).hexdigest()
 h.obj(case.brief["payload"])["prompt_bundle_ref"]=records.reference(b)
 h.rebind_mutation(case)
def historical(case):
 case.checker=records.envelope("method-checker",{**identity.descriptor(),"code_digest":DIGEST})
results=[]
for state in ("complete","incomplete","unknown"):
 case=h.native_case(predicates=True,return_predicate="normalize-records" if state=="incomplete" else "build-surface-map")
 if state=="unknown": case.schemas={}
 expected=state.upper()
 assert h.obj(case.check()["payload"])["status"]==expected
 before=[copy.deepcopy(h.obj(x["payload"]).get("value")) for x in h.rows(case.execution["records"]) if h.obj(x)["kind"]=="contract-artifact"]
 seal(case,PIN); historical(case)
 received=h.obj(case.check(receive_only=True)["payload"])
 assert received["status"]==expected
 if state=="unknown": assert str(received["reason"]).startswith("METHOD_SCHEMA_UNAVAILABLE;")
 after=[copy.deepcopy(h.obj(x["payload"]).get("value")) for x in h.rows(case.execution["records"]) if h.obj(x)["kind"]=="contract-artifact"]
 assert before==after
 denied=h.obj(case.check(receive_only=False)["payload"])
 assert denied["status"]=="UNKNOWN" and str(denied["reason"]).startswith("METHOD_CHECKER_UNAVAILABLE;")
 results.append({"control":state,"receive_only_status":received["status"],"reason":received["reason"],"new_admission_consumer_status":denied["status"],"artifact_values_preserved":True})
case=h.native_case(predicates=True)
modern=h.obj(case.prompt_bundle["payload"])["composer_revision"]
for label,pin in (("modern",modern),("wrong_retained","c16e5e4c09eb302d52c4efb5df979a3669950d75a47fc61f9e00df37b3a70b36")):
 seal(case,pin)
 case.checker=records.envelope("method-checker",identity.descriptor())
 assert h.obj(case.check(receive_only=True)["payload"])["status"]=="COMPLETE"
 historical(case)
 denied=h.obj(case.check(receive_only=True)["payload"])
 assert denied["status"]=="UNKNOWN" and str(denied["reason"]).startswith("METHOD_CHECKER_UNAVAILABLE;")
 results.append({"control":label,"current_checker":"COMPLETE","historical_checker":denied["status"],"reason":denied["reason"]})
seal(case,PIN)
assert identity.verify(case.checker,pin=PIN,receive_only=True,zero_predicates=False)==case.checker
for label,pin,receive in (("new_admission",PIN,False),("zero_pin","0"*64,True)):
 try: identity.verify(case.checker,pin=pin,receive_only=receive,zero_predicates=False)
 except CatalogError as e: assert e.reason=="METHOD_CHECKER_UNAVAILABLE"; results.append({"control":label,"refusal":e.reason})
 else: raise AssertionError("historical identity incorrectly admitted")
print(json.dumps({"boundary":"SOURCE_SYNTHETIC_RETAINED_RESEAL_NOT_HISTORICAL_PROVENANCE","controls":results},indent=2))
